coordinates.note: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap geocoder) centroid of the Wilson Synchrotron Laboratory building, Cornell campus, Ithaca. Campus-grade only: the CESR ring (a half-mile-scale tunnel beneath the Cornell athletic fields) and the CLEO and CUSB halls are not individually located by any source consulted.

name: Wilson Synchrotron Laboratory (Cornell University)
notes: Campus point only; the CLEO and CUSB experimental halls are not separately located by any source consulted.

summary.plain: The Wilson Synchrotron Laboratory on the Cornell University campus in Ithaca, New York, which houses the Cornell Electron Storage Ring and, for 1979 to 2008, the CLEO and CUSB experiments.
summary.technical: Wilson Synchrotron Laboratory, 161 Synchrotron Drive, Cornell University, Ithaca NY. Geocoder (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) building centroid, about 300 m precision; the CESR tunnel lies beneath the surrounding campus.
